egress.terms: Unmetered volumetric traffic mitigation included with every plan; the gaming plan bills USD 0.03 per average player per day and the server plan USD 0.02 per GB of transmit bandwidth; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: Signup portal at cosmicguard.com/signup; billing is pay-as-you-go.
chaining: Fronts a public origin with arbitrary UDP; would front a free VM's UDP port at roughly USD 22 per TiB of transmit.

limits.value: USD 0.02 per GB transmit on the server plan
gaming plan is billed per average player per day at USD 0.03

binding_note: At 1 TiB/month on the server plan the transmit meter is what runs: 1 TiB is 1099.5 GB, so about USD 22 per month at the published USD 0.02/GB, assuming transmit only. That figure is arithmetic on the vendor's rate, not a quote.

identity_cost.detail: Signup at cosmicguard.com/signup; the free trial is the only zero-cost path and the paid plans are metered. The signup form was not opened.

reliability_note: Mitigation is unmetered and flood traffic is not billed; the payable meter is players or transmit bytes.
confidence_note: The UDP claim, the per-player and per-GB rates and 'Start a free trial' are first-party. The trial's length and allowance are not published on the pages read.

evidence.proved: The service is described for Rust, FiveM, RedM, Minecraft (Java + Bedrock), Ark and 'any UDP game', including 'your own custom UDP daemon'
Gaming plan USD 0.03 per average player per day with unmetered mitigation and TCP/UDP compatibility; server plan USD 0.02 per GB transmit bandwidth
Six PoPs across NA and EU, sub-second mitigation, and the only zero-cost entry is 'Start a free trial'

price_per_tb_month: USD 0.03 per average player per day, or USD 0.02 per GB transmit
notes: It is the closest thing to free Cloudflare Spectrum in shape (arbitrary UDP, any port) and the furthest in price, since nothing is free after the trial.

extras.wg_detail: The product scrubs any public UDP port, so a WireGuard listener would be reachable through it; there is no free tier to do it on.
extras.volume_stated: Unmetered volumetric traffic mitigation included with every plan; the gaming plan bills USD 0.03 per average player per day and the server plan USD 0.02 per GB of transmit bandwidth
extras.transit_note: Cosmic Guard's six PoPs scrub and forward the traffic
